senses.definition: Australian aboriginal women with whom white men have sex.
senses.example: ‘Just can’t imagine anybody else havin’ a go at your missus while you’re away chasing black velvet in Mt Isa, can ya?’

senses.definition: Sexual intercourse with an Australian aboriginal woman.
senses.example: Black velvet — that is, the sexual abuse of Aboriginal women — had become highly topical with the publication of Coonardoo and Capricornia, and Miles’ choices in this area still seem reasonable.
